findingDetails.title: A hung leg blocks the battery forever
findingDetails.recommendation: Pass a per-leg timeout to spawnSync and normalize ETIMEDOUT to a leg failure whose repair names the rerun.

findingDetails.title: A nonzero probe exit is reported as printed no route decision
findingDetails.recommendation: Report the exit status when the probe exits nonzero; reserve the no-decision detail for empty or unparseable stdout.

findingDetails.title: The detail cap truncates FAIL lines while the repair says each
findingDetails.recommendation: Append an N-more marker when the slice drops lines so the each-FAIL-above repair stays true.

findingDetails.title: Repair and diagnostic branches lack test cases
findingDetails.recommendation: Add cases for the root-metadata not-built mapping, sync repair, malformed-JSON fallbacks, probe non-route detail and multi-failure runs.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Non-trivial multi-file target (command doc, route, workflow, script, tests, spec) with routing and repair contracts; correctness sweep warranted v2 depth fields.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Correctness core: the battery and its suite, plus the route/workflow/doc contracts that invoke it; the spec for requirement mapping.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Exit codes may not map to the documented route status (0 pass, 1 failure, 2 usage).

searchActions.result: main returns 0 when failed===0, 1 otherwise, 2 for usage; process.exitCode set, not process.exit.

searchLedger.rationale: Mapping matches the workflow exit-code contract and is asserted by the happy-path and bad-argument cases.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Verified by direct read and test assertions.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The provisioning skip gate may skip the wrong legs or run them anyway.

searchActions.result: The skip branch precedes the leg run and gates only parent-skill and root-metadata after a provisioning failure.

searchLedger.rationale: Gate order and membership match the spec edge case and the unprovisioned-tree test.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Asserted by the unprovisioned-tree case (two SKIP rows, failed=1 skipped=2).

searchLedger.hypothesis: A missing binary or malformed child output may crash the battery instead of failing one leg.

searchActions.result: spawnLeg normalizes an absent status to 1; parseJson fallbacks degrade to rerun repairs; the provisioning leg catches.

searchLedger.rationale: No crash path found in the spawn or parse layers; the no-stack assertion covers the provisioning path.

searchLedger.hypothesis: ROOT or require.resolve may target the wrong tree or break on fixture roots.

searchActions.result: ROOT resolves four levels above the script; the provisioning leg resolves through ROOT/node_modules, which the fixture suite populates.

searchLedger.rationale: Default and fixture roots both resolve as documented and as exercised by the suite.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Verified by direct read against the test fixtures.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Argument parsing may accept unknown flags or mishandle an empty prompt.

searchActions.result: parsePrompt rejects any non-prompt argument and an empty value with usage on stderr and exit 2.

searchLedger.rationale: Behavior matches the usage string and the bad-argument case.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The probe failure detail may misstate the observed condition and hide the exit status.

searchActions.result: probeDecision discards any nonzero exit before inspecting stdout; the judge emits one no-decision detail.

searchLedger.rationale: Nonzero exit with a printed decision is reported as no decision and the exit status is not surfaced.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A hung leg can block the battery without bound.

searchActions.result: spawnSync is called without a timeout option; a never-exiting child yields no status and no report.

searchLedger.rationale: No per-leg timeout exists on the single spawn call site.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The detail cap may hide failures while the repair tells the operator to fix each.

searchActions.result: failLines slices to ten entries with no remainder marker; the drift repair says fix each FAIL above.

searchLedger.rationale: Truncation is silent and the repair wording assumes completeness.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Repair and diagnostic branches may have no test coverage.

searchActions.result: Nine cases cover headline paths; root-metadata not-built, sync repair, parent-skill details, malformed-JSON fallbacks, probe non-route detail and multi-failure runs are untested.

searchLedger.rationale: Untested repair branches can regress silently.

detail: Correctness sweep of the /doctor:sk-code setup battery: leg order, skip gate, exit codes, repair rendering and probe decision parsing read line by line against the nine-case suite. Result: 0 P0, 0 P1, 4 P2.

reason: main returns 0 when failed===0, 1 otherwise, with 2 for usage, and sets process.exitCode; asserted by the happy-path and bad-argument cases.
PROVISION_DEPENDENTS is checked before each leg run and asserted by the unprovisioned-tree case (two SKIP rows, failed=1 skipped=2).
spawnLeg normalizes an absent status to 1; parseJson fallbacks degrade to rerun repairs; the no-stack assertion covers the provisioning path.
ROOT resolves four levels above the script and the fixture suite resolves @spec-kit/shared through ROOT/node_modules, matching the provisioning leg's paths option.
